hooks.text: An asteroid missed Earth to aim for the Moon.
A newly found space rock had a 3 percent strike risk.
The second-most threatening asteroid in history targeted our world.

title: The Asteroid That Missed Earth for the Moon
description: Discover how asteroid 2024 YR4 went from threatening Earth to risking a direct impact on the Moon.

beats.text: An asteroid missed Earth to aim for the Moon.

beats.text: Most people thought the space rock would safely sail past our planet.

queries: James Webb Space Telescope rendering space

beats.text: Automated tracking systems initially flagged a 3 percent chance of a direct collision.
beats.visual: Diagram of the Torino Scale impact hazard rating chart, 2024

beats.text: It reached a rating of 3 on the Torino scale.
beats.visual: Map of Earth displaying the impact risk corridor over South America and Africa, 2025

beats.text: Follow-up observations later ruled out any threat to Earth.

beats.text: Yet data revealed a lingering chance the impact target was actually lunar.

beats.text: This unexpected destination change kept astronomers on high alert.

beats.text: Its trajectory proved that deep space hazards can shift in surprising ways.
